attempts.sql: WITH cmd AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND name = 'Command' AND kind = 'class'), cmd_methods AS (SELECT s.name FROM code.symbols s JOIN cmd ON s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.symbol_id LIKE cmd.symbol_id || '.%' AND s.symbol_id NOT LIKE cmd.symbol_id || '.%.%'), grp AS (SELECT symbol_id FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'src/click/core.py' AND name = 'Group' AND kind = 'class') SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN grp ON s.file_id = 'src/click/core.py' WHERE s.kind = 'method' AND s.symbol_id LIKE grp.symbol_id || '.%' AND s.symbol_id NOT LIKE grp.symbol_id || '.%.%' AND s.name IN (SELECT name FROM cmd_methods) ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
Which methods of the Group class in src/click/core.py override a method that its base class Command (same file) defines itself under the same name? Count only methods written in the body of Command, not ones Command inherits; __init__ counts as an override. Give the symbol ID of the Group method.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds the Command class in src/click/core.py and collects the names of methods defined directly in its body (excluding nested symbols). It then finds methods defined directly in Group's body whose names match those Command methods, returning their symbol IDs.
